findings: Emperor's Divide chooses any number of friendly battlefield units at one location; Hidden and Action timings are distinct.
Tricksy Tentacles chooses an enemy group with one controller and total current Might at most 8; legal maximal subsets are chosen if responses break the collective budget.
Isolate links its conditional draw to the valid moved target's battlefield at resolution. A negated Move retains the linked check; a mistarget ignores it.
Move events resulting from one instruction form a simultaneous group; relocate every member before publishing its events.
Existing resolution_groups already provides location-group choices. An initial helper-only inspection incorrectly suggested automatic selection; full-path tracing corrected that suspicion.
